info.name: Tujitume API v1 - KYC / KYB
info.description: KYC/KYB API collection. Set base_url and bearer_token before use. Use one account type per run: entrepreneur (1), service provider (3), or organization (4).

request.description: This endpoint intentionally has no request payload. First call Start KYC, update the draft with the account-type PATCH request, and upload every document required for that flow. This request validates the stored draft and changes its status to submitted.
